invariants.rule: Player characters, NPCs and creatures reference one canonical SpeciesDefinition lineage; MVPS-15 never creates parallel NPC-only or creature-only species canon.
SpeciesDefinition, NPC/Creature definition, archetype/template and live instance identities remain distinct and may reference each other only through explicit owner-domain records.
Every species-facing reuse adapter preserves exact species/version and relevant lineage/form/adaptation/adjudication/provenance references rather than copying or flattening mechanics.
MNCS-14 owns NPC/Creature species/form composition and MNCS/PPIA owner domains retain canonical entity authority; MVPS-15 provides references and proof only.
Campaign, combat, social, exploration and crafting adapters are projection/mapping seams into their owner contracts and may not implement replacement domain engines or direct owner mutation.
Runtime/cast/session mappings remain proposal-only until accepted by the target owner; MVPS-15 does not mint canonical entities, live instances, cast membership or session state.
CharacterSpeciesSelection, player builder state and player presentation assets are not required for NPC/Creature reuse unless a specific owner workflow explicitly requests their projection.
Late-bound or unresolved MNCS/MCCS/MCS/campaign/combat/social/exploration/crafting dependencies remain explicit unresolved owner references; substitutes and semantics are never guessed.

enforcement.ci_step: Run MVPS-15 NPC creature reuse cross-system adapter regressions
